window: Past 24 hours, with search-index lag: the one new item was published by New Zealand police on 7 November. Searches of US federal, local US, South America and SOUTHCOM strike reporting found nothing new and verifiable; hits were already logged, from earlier years, or undated.

stories.headline: New Zealand's Operation Magpie nets cocaine, MDMA, ketamine and 70 kg of pseudoephedrine, with four men remanded
stories.summary: Canterbury organised-crime detectives and Customs announced on 7 November that several border consignments had been intercepted and warrants executed across Canterbury.
